interpretation_boundaries: The 2024 document is final FDA guidance; both 2026 documents are drafts, not for implementation, and contain non-binding recommendations.
FDA guidance does not provide one universal numeric threshold that establishes genome-editing safety or scalability.
Three lots and two blinded laboratories are internal preregistered engineering floors, not FDA universal minima.
Prior knowledge may reduce duplicated work only after applicability, granularity, and bridging are justified; it is not permission to borrow another product's safety conclusion.
This artifact contains no sequence, target, editor identity, disease indication, dose, culture condition, delivery recipe, wet-lab instruction, clinical recommendation, or claim of FDA compliance.
No product, cell, participant, assay outcome, lot, animal, patient, editor, model, intervention, safety, efficacy, scalability, regulatory, or solved-frontier claim is produced.
